notes.title: Hotfix 20.43
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Thanks for your continued feedback and support on Toads!

The latest Hotfix features:

Major changes:

- Fixed a bug where Veve Ouragan and Veve Poison could target friendly units
- Fixed a bug where Veve Ouragan could target non-pushable units
- Fixed a bug where roots could spawn on top of other objects
- Fixed a bug where the hero's tooltip would permanently disappear after clicking on its portrait
- Support Toad's drop rates now change depending on the run progression
- Fixed a bug about enemy AIs not sorting threats properly
- Removing cards now costs 6 Oil (previously 10) and 8 in Corruption mode (previously 12)
- Rioters now have 4 HP (previously 2)
- Sneak Out now costs 1AP to play
- Gumbo now costs 2AP to play
- Sacrifice now costs 1AP to play
- Silence now costs 1AP to play
- Howl now costs 1AP to play
- Fixed a bug where Penitence would reset and Shoot 0 when continuing a run
- Fixed a bug where Fungal Deliverance would not trigger On Discard effects

Minor changes:

- Barricade's description now includes that they let players draw 1 card when destroyed
- The option to replace random cards at the beginning of the run should not replace Step anymore

- Fixed a bug where the low HP idle animation would not be played when continuing a game
- Fixed a bug where combat music would not play when continuing a game

We hope everyone has a great Christmas!

La Grange 🐸

notes.title: Toads of the Bayou - October Playtest & Development Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave Toads!

We’re excited to share some important updates regarding the development of Toads of the Bayou. 

Over the past months, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes on the game. However, we have made the decision to disable the prologue.

Shifting Focus to the Main Game

Although the prologue was originally intended to give you an early taste of what’s to come, after much consideration we have decided to pivot away from releasing the prologue and instead focus all of our energy on delivering the complete version of Toads of the Bayou. 

This shift allows us to dedicate our full attention to refining the core game play, enhancing the roguelike deckbuilding mechanics, and creating a deeper, more polished experience. The cursed bayou, Baron Samedi’s tricks, and the intense strategic battles are being brought to life in a way that will be worth the wait.

Play the latest build of Toads of the Bayou!

Want to see what we've been working on and get hands-on with some toady mayhem? Our closed playtest is coming 8th October and we'd love for you to take part! 

To claim your key, all you need to do is join us on Discord and you'll be assigned a role. We'll be giving out the keys on Tuesday so please join before then. 

Sneak Peek: New Screenshots and GIFs

We’re thrilled to share new images and GIFs from the latest build of the game! These showcase our progress, including updated environments, combat animations, and synergies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/76e24ba13cba5609c97d045744ce1849596ae22b.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/b823066a3aa9c9904bcc483e781c75594618b97e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802478/c712f49461e5ed1b906c3c8aed3f62b1997dcb4e.gif

Make sure to follow us for regular updates, as we’ll be revealing more content in the coming months.

A slight change in our release date

With all the exciting new changes coming to Toads of the Bayou, we just need a little longer to cook. Our game will no longer be releasing in October, but we're not far off now - Toads of the Bayou will be coming very soon! 

Thank you for your understanding and continued support. We’re fully committed to delivering the best possible version of Toads of the Bayou, and we can’t wait to share the full adventure with you soon.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam!

La Grange 🐸

notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Since the playtest started, we put a lot of effort into applying your feedback, and we are really happy to share a new patch for the game! 

Our main focus was of course the UI/UX, since this was one of the most frequent points in your feedback. We took a lot of time re-thinking how the game should feel, and how to make the navigation easier based on your suggestions. 


🎮UI/UX:


When playing a card, you can now directly target the cell where you want to apply the effect
Buildings, trees, and props will now become 35% transparent when hiding a unit. Unit's silhouette opacity have been reduced to 15%, in order to subtly highlight the unit without compromising the battlefield readability
In the Combat Phase, card tooltips are now displayed next to the card
Card tooltips are now displayed in buildings and in the deck window
Card effect text is now updated with the toad's current stats
Hovering over a building in the Management Phase will display an icon (currently placeholder) to show that you can buy cards


We have also started integrating some of your feedback in terms of game design and balancing. 

📯Game Design/Balancing:

Burn now works with counters. An enemy will apply X Burn Counter to its target. 1* Burn Counter* is removed at the beginning of the turn, or anytime a card is played, the latter dealing 1 damage
Introduction of the Extinguish mechanic - some card effects reduce Burn Counters
Toads do not have a "movement range" stat anymore. Movement is based on cards effects, and on buffs.
Stabbing buff is now called Strength, and Shooting buff is now called Accuracy
Most of the card effects have been reworked to create more engaging combat situations
Building passives have been removed
Buildings will now only offer 3 cards. The player will have to place another building of the same type to buy more cards from it
Buildings will now offer 3 random cards, selected from their own card pool


And last but not least... new trees! 🔥🌳

Thank you so much to all of you. Once again, your feedback and suggestions are the key for us to make Toads of the Bayou the best we can, and it is an absolute thrill to see you all play the game and to hear your great ideas about the game in its current state. The playtest is still LIVE until 5th July, don't miss out on your chance to play and give us your thoughts  🐸❤️

You can join through our Discord and by following the instruction in the Announcement channel: discord.gg/JG9rgyXATM

The La Grange Team.
